measure_description: Originally measured with utils/measure script on 2024-01-28, with a Shelly Plug US from a bad batch that inflates power readings by a constant factor of 1.22x. Corrected on 2026-09-10 by dividing every LUT value and the standby power by 1.22. The correction factor was determined on 2026-09-06 on the sister profile sylvania/A19CCECWF, by remeasuring on a Sonoff S31 and cross-checking the bad Shelly Plug US against a Kill-A-Watt (1.22x at 1 W, 1.22x at 100 W, 1.20x at 950 W); this model was not remeasured. The corrected 8.05 W -> 6.60 W peak now sits underneath the lamp's 7 W rating.
name: SMART+ Wi-Fi Full Color Clear Filament A19 LED Bulb (7W)
